collection_record.note: The rows copied into the R3 window were collected by the dev pipeline; its pipeline_runs table is the record of which market-days completed.

quota.authority: GDELT public export and publisher RSS feeds carry no vendor quota.
Google Trends RSS and the public BigQuery trends dataset carry no vendor quota.
Apple Music public charts carry no vendor quota.

record.authority: src/ingestion/connectors/youtube.py quota accounting: four search.list calls at 100 units, one videos.list at 1 unit and five comment units per market per run against the YouTube Data API v3 daily budget of 10000. A market-day counts as collected when the pipeline_runs row is success and youtube_rows is above zero; the channel scrape carries no vendor quota.

Opened 4 Sep 2026 on Albert's word. Both families are collected by the SocialCrawl connector (src/ingestion/connectors/socialcrawl.py phases discover, creators, search, reddit, accounts). The pipeline_runs record counts their rows in socialcrawl_rows and the credits each market run actually spent in socialcrawl_credits, which is the usage; the bound is the socialcrawl.budget_credits_per_run breaker in configs/sources.yaml (620) times the three market runs a day, 1860. A market-day counts as collected when the pipeline_runs row is success and socialcrawl_rows is above zero.
